  ?class a beast .
  ?class hasXPValue ?avgExperiencePoints .
  FILTER ( ?class rdfs:label "Angel"@en || ?class rdfs:label "Demon"@en )
}

UNION

SELECT ?class ?avgExperiencePoints
WHERE {
  ?class a beast .
  ?class hasXPValue ?avgExperiencePoints .
  FILTER ( ?class rdfs:label "Angel"@en )
  FILTER ( ?avgExperiencePoints > ( SELECT AVG(?avgExperiencePoints2) WHERE { ?class2 a beast . ?class2 hasXPValue ?avgExperiencePoints2 . FILTER ( ?class2 rdfs:label "Demon"@en ) } ) )
}

UNION

SELECT ?class ?avgExperiencePoints
WHERE {
  ?class a beast .
  ?class hasXPValue ?avgExperiencePoints .
  FILTER ( ?class rdfs:label "Demon"@en )
  FILTER ( ?avgExperiencePoints < ( SELECT AVG(?avgExperiencePoints2) WHERE { ?class2 a beast . ?class2 hasXPValue ?avgExperiencePoints2 . FILTER ( ?class2 rdfs:label "Angel"@en ) } ) )
}
